# Gelabber v0.8.9

Integrated through #427 and #428 into `v0.8` and the version PR into `main`.

A release of the repository and its pipeline, without product changes: the
Rust sources, the web interface and the desktop app are the same as in
v0.8.8, apart from their version. No database migration, no `.env`,
`compose.yaml` or `Caddyfile` changes beyond the image pins.

## Repository

- **One folder per area (#427).** The Rust workspace (`api`, `media`,
  `shared`, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`) moved to `backend/`, and the Docker
  build helpers from `docker/` to `backend/build/`. Next to it stay `web/`,
  `desktop/`, `deploy/` and `docs/`. Rust commands run from `backend/`; the
  Docker builds still use the repository root as context.
- `AGENTS.md` keeps only rules that hold for every release; versions and
  history live in the release notes and in git.

## CI and releases

- **Only what a pull request touches (#427).** CI starts the backend, web,
  desktop, deployment and MinIO checks only for the folders a pull request
  changes; a change to `.github/` starts all of them. One check, `ci-ok`,
  sums them up. A pull request that only changes the web interface no longer
  waits for the Rust tests.
- **Releases by themselves (#427).** After a version PR is merged into
  `main`, CI and the image build run as before; `release.yml` then tags the
  new version, publishes the release and starts the desktop installers
  without anyone starting it by hand. This release is the first one to use
  that path.
- **Faster Rust tests (#428).** The tests run side by side with
  `cargo-nextest`: running them takes 191 s instead of about 510 s. The
  toolchain image reuses the cached layers of the media build (22 s instead
  of 54 s). Both measured on a pull request with an empty cargo cache.

## Upgrade notes

- Image pins `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to `v0.8.9`.
  The order does not matter for this release.
- Rollback: the v0.8.8 image set, all three together. The database is
  unchanged.
- Anyone building from source: `cargo` commands now run in `backend/`, and
  `docker/` is `backend/build/`.
- **Desktop, Windows:** the installer and `latest.json` are attached to this
  release; older apps offer the update.
- **Desktop, Linux (Arch):** update from the pacman repository.

## Open

- The automatic release path ran in tests and actionlint, not yet on `main`.
  If `release.yml` does not start after the image build, it can still be
  started by hand with the tag and the ID of the image run.
- The Rust test time with a warm cache has not been measured yet.
